{{Quote|This is the scientist's vessel. And look what I found hiding under a dead Imperial officer&hellip;|Leeha Narezz, after searching the ''Deference'' and finding Urrisov|<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />}}
The '''''Deference''''' was a [[Pythar-class Imperial shuttlecraft|''Pythar''-class Imperial shuttlecraft]] that belonged to a [[Unidentified Imperial scientist|scientist]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3665 BBY]], the ''Deference'' was shot down during the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]] and crashed into the [[Water/Legends|icy]] surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], and the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] remained buried in a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] system for [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]]. During the subsequent [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the Republic, the ''Deference'' was the subject of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mission to Hoth (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|mission]] to recover information from the shuttle's databanks.

==Description==
{{Quote|Find any profile that matches a ''Pythar''-class Imperial shuttlecraft.|Leeha Narezz, on the ''Deference''|<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />}}
The ''Deference'' was a [[Pythar-class Imperial shuttlecraft|''Pythar''-class Imperial shuttlecraft]], a small, [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] with short, curved wings on either side. The ''Deference'' had a minimum crew of one [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], and contained databanks, which the [[Unidentified Imperial scientist|Imperial scientist]] who owned the shuttle used to store his research.<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />

==History==
{{Quote|My job was to slice the databanks of this old starship, but the White Maw beat us to them. They lifted the whole network.|Urrisov|<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />}}
The ''Deference'' was used by a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], during which the scientist updated the defenses of the [[Emperor's Fortress|space fortress]] of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]].<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" /> In [[3665 BBY]],<ref name="Gnost">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref> the scientist was [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] the ''Deference'' in the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]] when it was shot down during the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]], a major [[Space warfare/Legends|naval engagement]] between the Empire and the Republic. The ''Deference'' crashed in the [[Highmount Ridge]] region&mdash;which [[Death/Legends|killed]] its scientist pilot&mdash;where it broke into a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] system within the ridge. [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] recorded the ''Deference''{{'s}} loss, but the Empire made no attempts to recover the [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />

Around [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|2}}</ref> the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] intelligence organization [[Raid on an Imperial Intelligence base|raided]] an [[Imperial Intelligence base]] and learned of the ''Deference''{{'s}} existence, and the SIS notified the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tol Braga]], who was working on a plan to capture the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. Braga then dispatched the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leeha Narezz]] to Hoth to recover the ''Deference'' so that their [[Jedi strike team (capture of the Sith Emperor)|strike team]] could obtain the schematics for the Sith Emperor's [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. However, the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] came across the wreck before Narezz could locate it, and they stole the shuttle's databanks&mdash;but they missed the decryption file, leaving them unable to read the information.<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />

[[File:Hoth_Rusk_Fight.png|thumb|right|250px|Sergeant Rusk's squad fights Imperial forces in search of the shuttle]]
An Imperial salvage team soon came across the ''Deference'' and began to excavate the shuttle, though they were interrupted by the arrival of Narezz and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight known as the [[Hero of Tython]], another member of the strike team. The Emperor's [[Imperial Guard]] attempted to capture the two Jedi in the caves, though the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]] and his [[Fideltin Rusk's squad|squad]] forestalled their efforts, and Narezz and the squad searched the shuttle for their prize&mdash;only to find that the databank was gone. After questioning an Imperial [[Technician/Legends|technician]] named [[Urrisov]] who had been captured during the fight, the Jedi and [[Republic trooper]]s learned of the White Maw's acquisition of the databank,<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" /> and they were able to track down the databank and acquire the schematics of the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] station.<ref name="Imperial Guard">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Imperial Guard|Hoth}}</ref>

==Commanders and crew==
The ''Deference'' was owned by an Imperial scientist who also served as the shuttle's pilot. The scientist went down with his vessel during the Battle of Hoth and died when the shuttle crashed on the ice planet.<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Deference'' first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown" />
